note: The points where tools/geo/photos.py makes the contact sheets of the street photos of Mapillary (plan 0009, R5e; plan 0026, report 0026 section 8.4). One point for each question. at: the point in game meters [x, z] (x to the east, z to the south). radius_m: the images in this distance. look: "toward" (the camera points to "target", or to "at" with no target, within 50 degrees), "any", or a list of compass directions (degrees from the north to the east, within 45 degrees). years: the first and the last year. dates: (optional) only the images in these days, [from, to] in the time of Vietnam. max: the most images on the sheets of the point.
